answer: Picture the attacker as a clerk who has to open a hundred files at a licensing office. Under Toll transponder history with road authority attestation, a transponder with trips over many years, which means no file opens without an issuer's signature and a registry entry to match it. One forgery takes weeks of paperwork and fees; a hundred take a hundred times that, and a single failed island check flags the whole batch. The fable is the registry the clerk cannot edit, and the hollow is the waiting period between application and approval that no script can skip.
